messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — running p95 SLO-driven batching canary on route=chat-slo-1. Observed sudden KV-hit rate drop and p95 jump after kernel selector change in last rollout. Initial baseline p95=120ms -> post-rollout p95=220ms across canary nodes 5/8.
Aj Kapoor: Which deploy/commit introduced the kernel selector tweak? link: https://ci.redwood/commit/abc123
Maria Chen: Deploy 2026-03-16T10:12Z (hash abc123). Kernel selector started preferring quant8 path for shorter sequences; suspicion: quant kernel's memory access pattern causing KV cache churn/eviction.
Samir Patel: Profiling traces from canary attached. Snippet of command used:
```
./profiling/run_batch_profile --route=chat-slo-1 --batcher=continuous --tokens=64 --out=trace.pb
# Observed: KV miss spike coinciding with kernel switchover, effective batch sizes drop from ~12->6
```
Elaine Wong: Saw similar spillover in perf-staging when prefix lengths are small and the selector flips kernels mid-prefetch. Kernel switch threshold currently set at 48 tokens; that boundary seems hot.
Maria Chen: Proposed quick mitigation for canary: lower dynamic token budget target for chat-slo-1 from 64 -> 48, increase KV prefetch window from 1 -> 3, and add kernel affinity override to prefer fp16_matmul on canary nodes.
Vikram Rao: I'll kick off canary-2 with the override and monitor. Planned config: 
```
batching:
  dynamic_token_target: 48
  kv_prefetch_window: 3
kernel_selector:
  affinity_overrides:
    - route: chat-slo-1
      prefer: fp16_matmul
```
perf-bot: canary-2 started on nodes rtx-8a-003..006 :rocket:
Aj Kapoor: Note this may increase token cost slightly (~2-4%) due to smaller batches, but tradeoff is acceptable to meet p95 SLO.
Maria Chen: Timeline: run for 4 hours, collect p95 and kv_hit. Success criteria: p95 < 150ms AND kv_hit > 85% before promote.
Elaine Wong: I'll watch kernel traces, KV eviction heatmap, and batch size distribution. Ping me if p95 flattens or kv_hit stalls. :eyes:
perf-bot: canary-2 30m report: p95=132ms, kv_hit=78% (kv_hit improving but below target). Continuing.
Samir Patel: If kv_hit plateaus under 80% we should also consider queue-policy tweak: favor homogenous-seq grouping (time_window=200ms) to restore larger effective batch sizes for this route. That likely helps kernel throughput without changing budgets.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Plan: keep canary-2 running. If kv_hit doesn't cross 85% after 2 hours, flip queue policy to grouping mode and run another 2-hour window. I'll open a follow-up thread with flamegraphs and per-kernel counters. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
